xmldoc.short_description: Invoke a Nelson assistant tool in the current session.

param_input_item.param_description: string scalar or character vector: the tool name, for example 'evaluate_nelson_code'.
scalar struct: the tool arguments, whose fields match the tool input schema.

param_output_item.param_description: scalar struct with fields success, output, error, image, data, and duration.

description.p: nelson.ai.mcp.call runs one of the Nelson assistant tools directly in the live interpreter, without the stdio transport used by nelson.ai.mcp.server.
It is the in-process bridge used by assistant loops such as nelson.ai.agent.

Available tools include evaluate_nelson_code, run_nelson_file, create_nelson_plot, get_nelson_workspace, get_nelson_help, find_nelson_symbol, lint_nelson_code, and check_nelson_code. See nelson.ai.mcp.info for the full list.
